attributes.name: Plasma Ooze
attributes.powers:
The Plasma Ooze is immune to the Acid, Bludgeoning, Mental, Piercing, and Poison traits. Damage dealt by the Plasma Ooze is dealt to each character at your location.

Before you act, succeed at a Strength 13 check or discard a weapon.
